# Run book: Measure a distance

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/measure-a-distance.md) | [Spec](../specs/measure-a-distance.md)

## Purpose

Show the pure great-circle calculation that needs no external service.

## Preconditions

- The signed-in user holds the geocode.use right (the admin role).

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Measure a distance"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/data/distance`:

1. **Measure.** London and Paris are filled in; press Measure. Expect: The distance in kilometres and miles and the initial bearing are shown.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Coordinates refused | A latitude is outside -90 to 90 or a longitude outside -180 to 180 | Enter decimal degrees within those ranges |
| Forbidden | The user lacks the geocode.use right | Sign in with the admin role |

Related framework features: OoBDev.SpatialServices (`GeoMath`).
